"The search for Vijaya Lakshmi Gali, an Indian tourist who fell into a sinkhole in Kuala Lumpur on August 23rd, has been suspended due to safety concerns. Gali disappeared after the pavement she was walking on gave way, plunging her into an 8-meter-deep hole, leaving only her slippers as a trace.

***

The extensive search involved tracker dogs, remote cameras, and ground-penetrating radar, yet no sign of her has been found. After eight days, the fire and rescue department deemed it too risky to continue sending divers into the unstable environment.

***

Dr. Zaliha Mustafa, a minister in the prime minister’s department, cited the safety and health of rescue personnel as the main reason for halting activity; the underground drainage system has been cleared, but to no avail.

***

* Portions of the underground drainage system were flushed with high-pressure water jets, and excavators were deployed to remove debris.

***

Earlier, two divers had briefly entered the sinkhole but were quickly withdrawn due to hazardous conditions, prior to reaching the obstacle. It was also revealed that a ground disturbance had been reported at the same place last year. Is there anything else I can help with?"
